== Summary ==
The "Grudge Match" at the [[2008 Match Play Championship]], January 2008 (Flickr caption by Nate Meeker). Meeker's next photograph is captioned "Booker after losing the Grudge Match to KTOD" ([[:File:James Booker 2008 Match Play Championship after the grudge match.jpg]]); KTOD is [[Steve Baroni]] ("KTOD dominates the MPC", [[:File:Steve Baroni 2012 Match Play Championship.jpg]]). [[James Booker]] (dark sweater, as in that photograph) faces Baroni (red sweatshirt).

== Source ==
Photo by [[Nate Meeker]], Flickr: [https://www.flickr.com/photos/53301220@N00/2173896463/ DSCN0091 Grudge Match] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2102/2173896463_aa2228ac8c_b.jpg). Album linked in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=254001#p254001 post by Meeker] (Nate Meeker), "Nate Meeker PICTURES!", Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, 7 January 2008, linking his Flickr album "MPC 2008 GG".
